fields.description: Exact client name as stored in the attendance sync service's `client` table (case-sensitive match).
fields.label: Client Name

fields.description: Base URL of the server running the manual-reprocess-capable instance (feat/client-reprocess-final) -- the one that accepts a date range + biometric userIds. e.g. https://xxxx.erwrds.com
fields.label: Reprocess Server Base URL

fields.description: Base URL of the always-on cron server (feat/Dockerfile) -- the one that runs the unattended hourly sync. Used only by the "Trigger Regular Sync" action (no date range/userIds). Optional if you only ever use manual reprocessing.
fields.label: Sync Server Base URL
